'''Imperial Mining Control''' was an area of [[Quesh]] that was controlled by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Quesh war]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Imperial Mining Control appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an area on Quesh.<ref name="SWTOR" />
